ficha_publicada.poderes: as the result of one of his father’s experiments. On his father’s death, Brin was misled into believing that he was an android. Taking the name Lone Wolf, Brin performed a number of he - roic deeds and was approached by the Legion for member - ship, but he declined. Aided by Light Lass (Ayla Ranzz), Brin was cured of his delusional belief, and after a period of recov- ery he entered the Legion Academy as one of its first trainees. After a successful mission infiltrating the Legion of Super-Vil- lians, Brin adopted the name Timber Wolf and was inducted as a full member of the Legion of Super-Heroes.
